mainEntity.name: What is Cognify and how does it work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cognify is an AI-powered platform that uses advanced language models to automatically summarize YouTube videos and podcasts. Simply paste a link or select a podcast episode, and Cognify generates structured summaries, extracts key moments, and creates study materials in seconds.

Cognify's summarization engine achieves 85-95% information capture accuracy, validated through user feedback loops and comparative testing against original content. Summaries preserve essential information while removing filler content and redundancies.

mainEntity.name: How many podcasts does Cognify support?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cognify supports 1,000+ podcasts across all major platforms, including Huberman Lab, Mel Robbins, The Joe Rogan Experience, Tim Ferriss Show, Andrew Tate, Naval Ravikant, Tony Robbins, Matthew Walker, and Dr. Peter Attia. New podcasts are added weekly.

Cognify offers both free and premium versions. The Free tier includes 5 summaries per month. Premium ($12.99/month) includes unlimited summaries, advanced insights, and full NoteVault access. Students qualify for a $4.99/month educational rate.

mainEntity.name: What makes Cognify different from competitors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cognify is the only platform optimized specifically for learning from podcasts and YouTube. Unlike general note-taking apps (Notion, Apple Notes), Cognify specializes in educational content. Unlike transcription services (Otter.ai), it summarizes and synthesizes knowledge across multiple episodes for deeper learning.

mainEntity.name: Is my data private and secure?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Cognify employs end-to-end encryption for all user notes and data. We never sell or share user data with third parties. The platform is GDPR and CCPA compliant with regular security audits and penetration testing.

mainEntity.name: Can I export my notes and summaries?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. All notes can be exported in multiple formats: Markdown (.md), PDF, and JSON. You maintain full control and ownership of your learning data. Exports can be done individually or in batch.
Typical processing time is 30 seconds to 2 minutes depending on content length and complexity. Premium users receive priority processing. Most podcast episodes are summarized in under 90 seconds.

NoteVault is Cognify's personal knowledge repository that automatically organizes your notes with semantic linking. It connects insights across multiple episodes, identifies patterns, and enables cross-content searching. It's like having a personal researcher organizing your learning.

mainEntity.name: Can I ask questions about the content I've consumed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Cognify's AI-powered Q&A system lets you ask natural language questions about any content you've summarized. The AI provides answers sourced from your consumed content with timestamps and citations.
